notes.subject: תשב פני
notes.rationale: Hebrew 'turn back the face of' means reject/refuse; rendered literally 'tanim bek pes' to keep the picture.

notes.subject: man i kapsaitim oil
notes.rationale: משיח here is the anointed king, so the Tanakh gloss 'man ol i kapsaitim oil long em' is used, not Masiak.

notes.subject: prayer to Yahwe
notes.rationale: Direct petition addressed to Yahwe Elohim, closing Solomon's dedication prayer.

notes.subject: לחסדי דויד
notes.rationale: 'The kindnesses of David' — kindnesses shown TO David (promises) or shown BY David (his deeds); JPS reads 'good deeds of David'.

translation: Yahwe Elohim, no ken tanim bek ⟨את⟩ pes bilong ol man bilong yu ol i kapsaitim oil long en; tingim ol khesed bilong David, wokboi bilong yu.

tokens.gloss: bilong ol man bilong yu ol i kapsaitim oil long en
